rule: Replace +/-inf with NaN, drop rows with any NaN
rationale: Inf/NaN come from zero-duration flows (division by 0 in Flow Bytes/s, Flow Packets/s); rate cannot be computed so the row is unusable

rule: Drop rows with Flow Duration < 0 or Flow IAT Min < 0
rationale: Durations and inter-arrival times cannot be negative (clock/parsing errors in CICFlowMeter)

rule: Add binary flags for Init_Win_bytes_* == -1 (values kept)
rationale: -1 means 'window not observed', not an error; dropping would remove 21% (fwd) to 27% (bwd) of PortScan-file rows. The flag lets models use 'missing' as information

rule: Flag (keep) 18 redundant columns: 10 constant + 8 exact copies
rationale: Kept so the all-features models see every original column; excluded only from the reduced comparison feature set (e.g. Subflow Fwd Packets == Total Fwd Packets, Fwd PSH Flags == SYN Flag Count)

rule: Remove exact duplicate rows (keep first) BEFORE splitting
rationale: Copies could land in both train and test, inflating scores (leakage)

rule: Drop all rows whose identical feature-vector appears with both labels
rationale: Same input with two labels is label noise; no model can get both right

rule: Encode target: is_scan = 1 if PortScan else 0
